title: Microsoft Windows DiagTrack Service Hard Link Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the DiagTrack service. By creating a hard link, an attacker can abuse the service to overwrite a chosen file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
